notes.text: img can use width/height attributes, with missing dimensions treated as zero for no-resource images; svg, canvas, video, iframe, and empty object elements use native 300x150 fallback dimensions with width/height attribute overrides; object elements without type/data resource hints lay out fallback children; audio elements without controls are non-rendered and audio controls use native 300x54 fallback dimensions; any element can use data-layout-width and data-layout-height metadata.
